challenges.title: AGENTS.md for a small repo
challenges.brief: Get the model to write a short AGENTS.md that any coding agent can follow for a small Python project.

items.label: Sections
items.value: Overview, Commands, Layout, Rules, Done means

criteria: Has the sections Overview, Commands, Layout, Rules and Done means.
The commands pip install -e .[dev], pytest and ruff check . appear exactly, inside code fences.
The paths src/invoice_tool/, tests/ and data/samples/ appear exactly.
Says never to change data/samples/ and never to read .env.
Under 80 lines.
No placeholders such as TODO, angle-bracket gaps, your-project or lorem ipsum.

challenges.title: README for a command-line tool
challenges.brief: Get the model to write a README that someone can act on without asking a question.

items.label: Name
items.value: site-check (checks a folder of HTML files for broken links)

criteria: Has the sections Install, Use, Configuration, Test and Limits.
The commands pip install site-check, site-check ./public and pytest appear exactly, inside code fences.
The names --external and SITE_CHECK_TIMEOUT and the default 10 appear exactly.
Says images are not checked yet.
Under 400 words.
No placeholders such as TODO, angle-bracket gaps, example.com/your-repo or lorem ipsum.

challenges.title: A release-notes skill
challenges.brief: Get the model to write a SKILL.md that turns the changelog into user-facing release notes.

items.label: Rewrite
items.value: For users; no internal ticket numbers

criteria: Front matter has name: release-notes and a description.
The description is 1 to 1024 characters and contains 'Use when'.
CHANGELOG.md, docs/releases/ and npm run docs:check appear exactly; the command is in a code fence.
Has a numbered Steps section and a Rules section.
Under 120 lines.
No placeholders other than the labelled <version> value.

challenges.title: MCP server note for a team
challenges.brief: Get the model to write the team's MCP-SERVERS.md: which server, the exact command to add it, what was checked and the rules.

items.label: Host
items.value: Claude Code, shared with the team (project scope)

items.label: Command
items.value: claude mcp add --transport http --scope project notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp

items.label: Outside content
items.value: Yes: page text comes from many writers

items.label: Sections
items.value: Servers, How to add, Checks done, Rules

criteria: Has the sections Servers, How to add, Checks done and Rules.
The command claude mcp add --transport http --scope project notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp appears exactly, in a code fence.
The names .mcp.json and /mcp appear.
Checks done names the publisher, the tools allowed, and whether the server fetches outside content.
A rule says editing or creating pages is not allowed.
Under 300 words; no placeholders.

challenges.title: Tool definitions for a library server
challenges.brief: Get the model to write a JSON list of three MCP tool definitions a model could choose and call correctly.

items.label: library_search
items.value: Search the catalogue by title or author; changes nothing

items.label: library_get_book
items.value: Get one book by id, such as bk_1234; changes nothing

items.label: library_place_hold
items.value: Place a hold on a book for a student id, such as st_5678; adds a record

items.label: Format
items.value: A JSON array only, no prose

criteria: Valid JSON array of exactly three objects named library_search, library_get_book and library_place_hold.
Each description is at least 60 characters and contains 'Use'.
Each inputSchema is valid JSON Schema with type object, a required list and additionalProperties false.
library_search has a field property with enum title and author.
The id properties use patterns that match bk_ and st_ ids.
Search and get have readOnlyHint true; place hold has readOnlyHint false and destructiveHint false.

challenges.title: Plan a three-page site build
challenges.brief: Get the model to plan a coordinator-and-workers build of a three-page site as a JSON graph, with a review before the merge.

items.label: Stages
items.value: Plan, styles, one step per page, review, final fix or merge

items.label: Each step
items.value: id, title, owner, dependsOn, changes, proof, budget

items.label: Review
items.value: Required, with kind "review": the contact page has a form

items.label: Format
items.value: JSON only, in the lesson's example shape

criteria: Has a plan step, a styles step, one step per page, a review step and a final fix or merge step.
Every step has a title, an owner, a changes list, a dependsOn list, a proof and a budget.
Dependencies point only to steps that exist, with no cycle.
No two steps that can run at the same time list the same file in changes.
The review step (kind review) depends on all three page steps and the styles step.
There are no loops, or every loop has an until exit test and a maxRounds cap.

challenges.title: Plan a capped fix loop with a held-out check
challenges.brief: Get the model to plan a build-grade-fix loop with an exit test, a cap and a final check on tests the builder never sees.

items.label: Function
items.value: parse_price(text) in src/price.py; turns "$1,299.00" into a number

items.label: Held-out tests
items.value: 8, in tests/held_out/; the builder never sees them

items.label: Stages
items.value: Tests, build, grade-and-fix loop, final held-out check

items.label: Each step
items.value: id, title, owner, dependsOn, changes, proof, budget

items.label: Loop
items.value: id, steps (what repeats), until (exit test), maxRounds, heldOut

items.label: Format
items.value: JSON only, in the lesson's example shape

criteria: Has a tests step, a build step, a grade-and-fix loop and a final held-out check.
Every step has a title, an owner, a changes list, a dependsOn list, a proof and a budget.
The loop is declared with its steps, an until exit test, maxRounds of 4 or less and a heldOut note.
No cycle except inside the marked loop.
No two steps that can run at the same time list the same file in changes.
The held-out check comes after the loop, and no step in or before the loop reads or changes tests/held_out/.

challenges.title: A findings report with sources
challenges.brief: Get the model to write FINDINGS.md that answers a question from given sources, ties each claim to a source and lists what was not verified.

items.label: Claude Code
items.value: Reads CLAUDE.md; reads AGENTS.md instead when there is no CLAUDE.md

items.label: OpenAI Codex
items.value: Reads AGENTS.md, up to 32 KiB combined by default

items.label: Gemini CLI
items.value: Reads GEMINI.md; other names via context.fileName

items.label: Sections
items.value: Question, Answer, Claims, Sources, Not verified, Cross-check

criteria: Has the sections Question, Answer, Claims, Sources, Not verified and Cross-check.
CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, context.fileName and 32 KiB appear exactly.
Sources lists the three given links exactly.
Not verified mentions the free-tier question.
Under 450 words; no placeholders.
